notes.content: The BA in Theatre Arts is an approved match to the AA-T in Theatre Arts.
notes.contentHtml: The BA in Theatre Arts is an approved match to the AA-T in Theatre Arts.

notes.content: 8 units of Practicum and 6 courses selected from Electives are required for the major, totaling 26 units. Of these 26 units, 9 units MUST be upper division. Carefully select courses to ensure the minimum upper division unit requirement is met.
notes.contentHtml:
• 8 units of Practicum and 6 courses selected from Electives are required for the major, totaling 26 units.
  • Of these 26 units, 9 units MUST be upper division.
  • Carefully select courses to ensure the minimum upper division unit requirement is met.

notes.content: In sections below where the student is directed to select courses and there is a note "Only lower division courses listed," upper division courses are also available. See the University Catalog for the full listing of degree requirements.
